annotations.title: Get the payment link for an order

description: Returns the link to WaitApp's payment page for one of the connected person's own orders that still has an amount to pay now (an order placed with online payment, or a pre-order with a deposit). The person opens the link, sees the exact charge, and pays it themselves; this tool charges nothing and sends no payment prompt. Find the order by orderCode (with restaurantId if the same code exists at two venues) or by orderId from list_my_orders.

orderCode.description: The order code returned when the order was placed, e.g. WA-K4M2

restaurantId.description: The venue the order was placed at (needed with orderCode if the person has the same code at two venues)

name: get_payment_link
